eligibility.findConstruct: Only walks a leading Let chain; does not discover a constructor nested under a Branch or Region.
eligibility.producer: Requires the chosen local to be the returned value and exactly one Construct in the entire scanned body; permits one through seven fields.

unchangedHotAllocations.observation: Pending/Direct scheduler continuations still build StackMore followed by RunState; the enclosing advance code branches on progress. This is not the admitted straight-line single-constructor producer shape.

decision.action: Retain accepted R12; do not reintroduce rejected G32 or start an unqualified source cutover.
reason: G32 really removes a hot MetadataTables intermediate: 19,258,235 checker invocations, not a rare path. It leaves Arena/Tuple and the dominant sampled scheduler RunState/StackMore allocation sites.

Complete logical boundaries localize the added emit work to transport/lower handoff and link/validation, not BIR construction or source assembly. Width analysis is entered both before transformation and during renderer validation.
The native seed checker is compiled by canonical comp.ts; merely adding a selfhost BIR pass does not give that already compiled checker the JS vector worker box-elimination benefit.
Checker allocation estimates disagree in direction across windows. Neither GC causation, retained-memory reduction nor the cause of the earlier check-time variation is established.

Reaching the measured scheduler shapes would require conditional/nested producer and continuation ownership handling outside the current eligibility contract. Removing an input validation or special-casing scheduler names would not constitute a demonstrated safe correction.
decision.qualification: No production correction was introduced, so no fresh native build, new fixedpoint or consumer qualification is claimed. Existing G32 rejection and accepted R12 remain unchanged.

verification.actualRuns: One control/candidate checker-profile pair, one native-emit sample pair, one exact frequency run, one real-emit profile pair and one complete logical-interval pair on the full frozen root.
verification.hardGuards: Every heavy child retained 8192 MiB footprint/RSS, 600000 ms, 10 ms polling; Node workers retained 256 MiB stack, 6144 MiB old and 128 MiB young generation.
verification.semanticOutput: All complete emission runs matched their corresponding original authenticated full-root output hashes; marker and frequency images are diagnostics only.

limitations: This is a measured diagnostic checkpoint, not a new accepted compiler version or a speedup claim.
Raw images, ASTs, profiles, logs and bulk source archive remain outside Git.
No relative-memory heuristic or new performance acceptance threshold was introduced.

constraints: No working R12 compiler edits during measurement.
All heavy executions are serial and parent-owned.
Profiles, counters and trace overhead are separate diagnostics, never clean performance evidence.
Use one actual compiler image/module instance per lane for parse/expand/check/emit, matching original throughput residency.
GC event durations, CPU samples and allocation estimates have distinct clocks/meanings; preserve boundary limitations.
